description_en: Query the list of device registration policies for your Alibaba Cloud account
description_zh: 查询当前阿里云账号下设备注册策略列表
name: ListRegistrationPolicies

parameters.help_en: The current page number for paged queries. Values range from 1 to 10000
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时显示的当前页的页码。取值：1~10000
parameters.name: current_page

parameters.help_en: The number of items per page for paged queries. Values range from 1 to 500
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时设置的每页数量。取值：1~500
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The name of the device registration policy. It can be 1 to 128 characters long. It supports Chinese characters, uppercase and lowercase English letters, numbers, periods (.), underscores (_), and hyphens (-)
parameters.help_zh: 设备注册策略名称。长度为1~128个字符，支持中文和大小写英文字母，可包含数字、半角句号（.）、下划线（_）和短划线（-）
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en:
The user group ID. Get this value from:

[ListUserGroups](~~ListUserGroups~~): Batch query user groups.

[CreateUserGroup](~~CreateUserGroup~~): Create user groups
parameters.help_zh:
用户组ID。取值来源：
[ListUserGroups](~~ListUserGroups~~)：批量查询用户组。
[CreateUserGroup](~~CreateUserGroup~~)：创建用户组
parameters.name: user_group_id

parameters.help_en:
The type of company device registration limit. Valid values:

Unlimited: No limit.

LimitAll: Limit by total number.

LimitDiff: Limit by device categorization
parameters.help_zh:
公司设备注册限制类型。取值：
Unlimited：不限制。
LimitAll：按照总数限制。
LimitDiff：按照终端分类限制
parameters.name: company_limit_type

parameters.help_en:
The type of personal device registration limit. Valid values:

Unlimited: No limit.

LimitAll: Limit by total number.

LimitDiff: Limit by device categorization
parameters.help_zh:
个人设备注册限制类型。取值：
Unlimited：不限制。
LimitAll：按照总数限制。
LimitDiff：按照终端分类限制
parameters.name: personal_limit_type

parameters.help_en:
The status of the device registration policy. Valid values:

Enabled: Enabled.

Disabled: Disabled
parameters.help_zh:
设备注册策略状态。取值：
Enabled：开启。
Disabled：关闭
parameters.name: status

parameters.help_en:
The policy matching target type. Valid values:

UserGroupAll: Associate all users.

UserGroupNormal: Associate some user groups
parameters.help_zh:
策略匹配目标类型。取值：
UserGroupAll：关联全体用户。
UserGroupNormal：关联部分用户组
parameters.name: match_mode

parameters.help_en: A collection of device registration policy IDs. You can enter up to 100 device registration policy IDs
parameters.help_zh: 设备注册策略ID集合。最多可输入100个设备注册策略ID
parameters.name: policy_ids

Policies.description_en: The list of device registration policies

CreateTime.description_en: The creation time of the device registration policy
CreateTime.description_zh: 设备注册策略创建时间

Description.description_en: The description of the device registration policy
Description.example: 这是一条设备注册策略。

LimitDetail.description_en: The list of device registration policy limit details
LimitDetail.description_zh: 设备注册策略限制详情列表

items.description_en: Details of a device registration policy limit
items.description_zh: 设备注册策略限制详情

DeviceBelong.description_en:
The device ownership. Valid values:

Company: Company device.

Personal: Personal device
DeviceBelong.description_zh:
设备归属。取值：
Company：公司设备。
Personal：个人设备

LimitCount.description_en: The number of device registration limits

All.description_en: The total number of device registration limits. This field is valid when the device registration limit type is LimitAll
All.description_zh: 设备注册限制总数。当设备注册限制类型为LimitAll时，该字段的值有效

Mobile.description_en: The number of mobile client log ons allowed for device registration. This field is valid when the device registration limit type is LimitDiff
Mobile.description_zh: 设备注册限制移动端登录数量。当设备注册限制类型为LimitDiff时，该字段的值有效

PC.description_en: The number of PC client log ons allowed for device registration. This field is valid when the device registration limit type is LimitDiff
PC.description_zh: 设备注册限制PC端登录数量。当设备注册限制类型为LimitDiff时，该字段的值有效

LimitType.description_en:
The type of device registration limit. Valid values:

Unlimited: No limit.

LimitAll: Limit by total number.

LimitDiff: Limit by device categorization
LimitType.description_zh:
设备注册限制类型。取值：
Unlimited：不限制。
LimitAll：按照总数限制。
LimitDiff：按照终端分类限制

MatchMode.description_en:
The policy matching target type. Valid values:

UserGroupAll: Associate all users.

UserGroupNormal: Associate some user groups
MatchMode.description_zh:
策略匹配目标类型。取值：
UserGroupAll：关联全体用户。
UserGroupNormal：关联部分用户组

Name.description_en: The name of the device registration policy

PolicyId.description_en: The ID of the device registration policy

Priority.description_en: The policy priority for device registration. A value of 0 indicates the highest priority, and 99 indicates the lowest priority
Priority.description_zh: 设备注册策略优先级。数字0表示优先级最高，数字99表示优先级最低

Status.description_en:
The status of the device registration policy. Valid values:

Enabled: Enabled.

Disabled: Disabled
Status.description_zh:
设备注册策略状态。取值：
Enabled：开启。
Disabled：关闭

UserGroupIds.description_en: A collection of user group IDs for the device registration policy. This field has a value when the policy matching target type is UserGroupNormal
UserGroupIds.description_zh: 设备注册策略，用户组ID集合。当策略匹配目标类型为UserGroupNormal时，该字段有值

items.description_en: The user group ID for the device registration policy when the policy matching target type is UserGroupNormal
items.description_zh: 设备注册策略，策略匹配目标类型为UserGroupNormal时的用户组ID

Whitelist.description_en: The whitelist of users for the device registration policy
Whitelist.description_zh: 设备注册策略白名单用户列表

items.description_en: A whitelisted user for the device registration policy
items.description_zh: 设备注册策略白名单用户

TotalNum.description_en: The total number of device registration policies
